Cors._comment: Nothing else on purpose. Enabled and AllowedOrigins come from .env as CORS_ENABLED and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, and any key written here would shadow the file, because appsettings has the higher priority. An empty string counts as written just as much as a filled one. An origin is per-machine - it is whichever address this machine serves the SPA from.

Recaptcha._comment: No SecretKey on purpose. It comes from .env as RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, and a placeholder here would shadow the real value because appsettings has the higher priority.

Auth._comment: No SigningKey on purpose. It comes from .env as JWT_SIGNING_KEY, and a placeholder here would shadow the real value because appsettings has the higher priority. AccessLifetime is short because that token cannot be withdrawn; RefreshLifetime is long because that one is stored hashed and can be revoked outright.
